intent: Two workstreams in one spec. First: fix the truth defects the operator found by hand-testing — the admission wizard shows a ₹500 application fee that is never actually charged (remove it), the parent documents screen claims 'Verified by School Administration' unconditionally even with zero uploads, no admin action can ever mark a document verified, and students created outside the admissions wizard never get linked to a parent account so the parent app shows 'No Student Profile Linked'. Second: make the parent app what it should be — not just bus tracking and fees, but a curriculum-anchored, Instagram-style home feed of what is actually happening in the child's classroom: homework posts, classwork summaries, syllabus coverage, and upcoming assessments, all derived from the existing syllabus_units/chapters/topics, lesson_plans, and assignments tables and personalized to the ward's class, section, subject enrollments, and current term. The teacher app gets the matching authoring surfaces: post homework, mark classwork done, and track syllabus progress — because a parent feed is only as alive as the teacher's ability to feed it. Every card in every feed must open real data in a real modal. No dead cards, no fake badges, no phantom fees.

meta.stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind dark-mode, lucide-react, drizzle-orm + PostgreSQL with RLS, vitest, cmdk, zod
meta.dependency_policy: NO new npm dependencies. Everything builds on existing tables (syllabus_units, syllabus_chapters, syllabus_topics, lesson_plans, assignments, assignment_submissions, assessments, academic_terms, student_subject_enrollments, parentFeedCards, teacherFeedCards).

database/drizzle/** (only if a column is strictly required; prefer zero migrations)

current_state_audit: Entity engine E1-E7 all landed (b84a19b7, 2845db55, 3736db69, da27e95b, 2832a42d, 76b13691, 6354f4fa) plus core fixes b7ce453f; head bfa4a9cf = v11.20.0.

Admission wizard (frontend/src/app/(admin)/admissions/new/AdmissionsWizard.tsx) step 5 'Fee Structure Preview' displays a hardcoded ₹500 'Application Fee — Non-refundable registration fee'. No payment integration exists anywhere in the flow: submitAdmissionApplication in actions.ts never charges, logs, or records any ₹500. It is a phantom fee and must be removed; wizard renumbers from 6 steps to 5.

AdmissionsWizard step 4 makes all four document uploads optional ('Documents are optional during initial admission') and the review step correctly shows amber 'Pending (Parent App)' chips — that part is truthful. The submit action only inserts admissionDocuments rows for files actually uploaded, with isVerified defaulting false. This is correct.

Parent documents screen (frontend/src/app/(parent)/parent/documents/ParentDocumentsClient.tsx) hardcodes the banner 'DPDP Encrypted Storage • Verified by School Administration' unconditionally — rendered even when the ward has zero documents and nothing has ever been verified. DPDP misrepresentation; must derive from actual state.

The per-document status badges in ParentDocumentsClient are logically correct (Verified only when matchingDoc.isVerified, else 'Pending Review', else 'Not Uploaded'). The defect is the banner plus the fact that isVerified can never become true through the product: no admin UI action exists to verify or reject a document. verifiedById/verifiedAt are write-once columns nothing writes.

backend/src/lib/studentLifecycleEngine.ts is a comprehensive 18-layer enrollment pipeline: provisions persons, students, class history, parent user account (by email, with claim token + temp password), PARENT role, primaryParentUserId link, family members with search hashes, document duplication, consent attestation, concessions, fee structures, subject enrollments, audit log, domain event. The linkage code path exists and is correct WHEN enrollment goes through this engine.

DEFECT in the engine: the parent user lookup is tx.query.users.findFirst({ where: eq(users.email, emailNormalized) }) with NO schoolId scoping — a parent account from another school can be silently linked as primaryParentUserId for this school's student (cross-tenant). Must scope by schoolId.

DEFECT (operator-observed): students created through ANY path other than the admissions wizard — direct admin creation in the Students module, bulk import — never receive primaryParentUserId. Parent logs in, parent app shows 'No Student Profile Linked'. The engine is the only code path that writes the linkage.

DEFECT: parent app ward queries are inconsistent. The dashboard scopes correctly (schoolId + primaryParentUserId + isActive). fetchParentStudentDocuments and checkParentConsentStatus in (parent)/portal/actions.ts query students by primaryParentUserId with NO schoolId and NO isActive filter, and contain an admin 'demoStudent' fallback (db.query.students.findFirst() — first student in the entire table, any tenant). Cross-tenant leak; remove.

Parent feed today (deriveParentFeed + ParentDataSnapshot) already includes a HomeworkSnapshot: assignments for the ward's section within ±14 days joined to submissions and real subject names. Good foundation — but there are no classwork posts, no syllabus coverage, no curriculum progress, no assessment schedule cards, and the feed is widget-priority, not a chronological stream.

Curriculum schema is fully built and unused by both role apps: syllabus_units → syllabus_chapters → syllabus_topics (Rule #8 three-level curriculum), lesson_plans with syllabusTopicId + status PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED + objectives + homework + plannedDate/completedDate (class-level, not section), assignments (sectionId + classSubjectId + status DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED/GRADED + dueDate + attachment), assignment_submissions, assessments with syllabusCoverage text, academic_terms (isActive), student_subject_enrollments (electives), classSubjects. Everything the academic feed needs already exists.

Teacher app route tree: attendance, classes, dashboard, grading, more, payroll, profile, ptm. There is NO homework/assignment authoring surface and NO lesson-plan/classwork surface anywhere in the teacher app. Teachers cannot post homework from their own app; only the admin academics module can create assignments. The teacher feed (deriveTeacherFeed via snapshotAssembler) is well wired for attendance/grading/timetable but has no homework-due cards.

Teacher dashboard and parent dashboard are both real-data wired (resolveTeacherScope / assembleTeacherSnapshot / withTenant). The grading, ptm, and payroll teacher pages plus parent attendance/fees/bus/messages pages were asserted wired in T/P specs; this spec re-audits them per AC and fixes what is found, rather than assuming.

remove_500_fee: Delete step 5 (Fee Structure Preview) from AdmissionsWizard.tsx entirely: the ₹500 card, the 'Non-refundable registration fee' copy, and the 'First-term tuition fees...' note. The wizard becomes 5 steps: DPDP Notice, Basic Info, Family, Documents, Confirm. Renumber the stepper, the handleNext guards, and the review step references.

Do NOT replace it with another hardcoded amount. Actual fee obligations are generated post-enrollment by autoAssignFeeStructuresToStudent, which is the only legitimate source of fee truth. The confirm step may show a single neutral line: 'Fee structure and first invoice will be generated on enrollment.'
Grep the whole repo for any other hardcoded 500-rupee application fee references (validators, seeders, docs) and remove them from the admission path.
document_truth: ParentDocumentsClient banner becomes state-derived: with zero documents show 'Encrypted storage • No documents on file'; with unverified documents show 'Encrypted storage • Awaiting school verification'; with all-verified show the verified line. Never claim verification that did not happen.

Admissions detail page (admin): each uploaded document gets Verify and Reject actions (PARENT/PRINCIPAL/SCHOOL_ADMIN only). Verify sets isVerified=true + verifiedById + verifiedAt (server action, requireAuth, tenant-scoped, auditLogs WRITE entry). Reject sets a rejection note; rejected docs show an amber state, not Verified.
Student profile (admin Students module) documents section gets the same Verify/Reject actions operating on studentDocuments rows.
The Verify action is the ONLY code path that writes verifiedById/verifiedAt. The engine's document duplication keeps copying isVerified as-is; nothing auto-verifies.

parent_student_linkage.engine_scoping_fix: In StudentLifecycleEngine.enrollApplicant, the parent user lookup becomes and(eq(users.email, emailNormalized), eq(users.schoolId, schoolId)). A parent with the same email in a different school gets a separate account in this school, never a cross-tenant link.
parent_student_linkage.all_creation_paths: Every student creation path must attempt the same parent linkage: (a) wizard enrollment via the engine (already does), (b) direct admin student creation in the Students module, (c) bulk import. Extract the parent provisioning + linkage block from the engine into a shared helper (provisionOrLinkParent) in backend/src/lib so all three paths call it: match by mobileSearchHash/emailSearchHash on studentFamilyMembers or by email, else provision account + claim token exactly as the engine does today.
parent_student_linkage.linkage_repair_tool: New admin surface in the Students module: 'Parent Linkage' audit tab. Lists students with isActive=true and primaryParentUserId=null, with the ward's guardian mobile/email available for matching. Per row: 'Find Parent' (search users by mobile/email hash within school), 'Link' (sets primaryParentUserId after admin confirm), or 'Invite Parent' (runs provisionOrLinkParent). Batch view for schools with many unlinked students. Every action writes an auditLogs entry.
parent_student_linkage.integrity_test: Vitest: after direct admin creation, the student row has primaryParentUserId set or is explicitly flagged unlinked with a repair-queue entry; the engine path always links when email is present; cross-school email never links.

ward_scope_consistency.shared_resolver: One shared server helper resolveParentWards(ctx): students where schoolId AND primaryParentUserId AND isActive, returning decrypted display names + class/section. The dashboard, documents, fees, bus, attendance, messages, profile pages and portal actions ALL use it. No page re-implements the query.
ward_scope_consistency.fallback_removal: Delete the demoStudent fallback (db.query.students.findFirst()) from fetchParentStudentDocuments and checkParentConsentStatus. Admins previewing the parent app use the existing ?studentId= pattern from the dashboard, scoped to their own school.
ward_scope_consistency.audit_directive: Walk every page under (parent)/parent and (parent)/portal: each must resolve wards through the shared resolver and scope every subsequent query by both studentId and schoolId. Fix anything found; the acceptance test enumerates the pages.

business_logic_rules: BR1: No hardcoded fee amounts anywhere in the admission flow. The only fee truth is autoAssignFeeStructuresToStudent post-enrollment.

BR2: A document shows 'Verified' if and only if isVerified=true, which only the admin verify action sets, which always writes verifiedById + verifiedAt + an auditLogs entry. Rejection is a visible state. The parent documents banner derives from real counts.
BR3: Every student creation path attempts parent linkage. A student that ends up unlinked is visible in the admin Parent Linkage queue the same day — never a silent failure.
BR4: Parent-user lookups are always scoped by schoolId. Ward queries are always schoolId + primaryParentUserId + isActive. The demoStudent cross-tenant fallback is deleted.
BR5: Homework reaches the parent feed only when status=PUBLISHED and sectionId matches the ward's current section and the subject is in the ward's enrollments. DRAFT is invisible to parents.

BR6: Classwork cards come only from lessonPlans with completedDate set, visible for 7 days, class-level (lesson plans are class+subject scoped per schema; a ward in any section of the class sees them).
BR7: Syllabus structure is admin-owned. Teachers and parents only ever read units/chapters/topics; progress is derived (lessonPlans completed), never stored on syllabus rows.
BR8: The feed is chronological by occurredAt desc with a single pinned Needs Attention strip. Weekly digest cards appear at most once per ward per week.
BR9: Every feed card opens a real detail modal with real data within one tap. No card may render without a resolvable detail source.
BR10: Teacher authoring scope is enforced server-side via resolveTeacherScope on every write: own classSubjects + own sections only.
BR11: Classwork generates no parent push. Homework publish and assessment schedule do, following the existing notificationMatrix delivery patterns and quiet hours.
BR12: All new queries run inside withTenant / RLS boundaries; decryption only in server components/actions; no PII in feed card payloads beyond what parents already see for their own ward.
BR13: Content write points added or touched in this spec (homework description, classwork homework text) route through the existing scanContentForPII middleware from entity-engine E3.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The admission wizard runs 5 steps; no ₹500, no 'Application Fee', no hardcoded amount appears anywhere in the admission flow; a repo grep test for the removed strings in the admissions path passes.
AC-2: With zero documents uploaded, the parent documents screen never renders the word 'Verified' in its banner; with an unverified doc it shows an awaiting-verification state derived from data.

AC-3: An admin can Verify and Reject an admission document and a student document from the UI; Verify writes isVerified, verifiedById, verifiedAt, and an audit log row; the parent documents card reflects the new state on next load.
AC-4: The engine's parent lookup is schoolId-scoped: an integration test proves a same-email user from school A is not linked as parent of a student in school B.

AC-5: A student created via direct admin creation (not the wizard) gets primaryParentUserId set by the shared helper when a parent matches, or appears in the Parent Linkage queue when not; the queue lists every active unlinked student in the school.
AC-6: Admin 'Link' and 'Invite Parent' actions set primaryParentUserId; a linked parent logging into the parent app immediately sees the ward's feed with real data (operator's original bug closed).

AC-7: All parent pages resolve wards through one shared resolver (schoolId + primaryParentUserId + isActive); the demoStudent fallback is gone; an enumeration test covers every page under (parent)/parent and (parent)/portal.

AC-8: Publishing homework in the teacher app produces a HomeworkPostCard in the correct section's parents' feeds within one refresh cycle, with subject, due badge, and submission chip; DRAFT homework never appears.
AC-9: Marking classwork done produces a ClassworkPostCard visible to the class's parents, showing chapter and homework line; the card auto-expires after 7 days.

AC-10: SyllabusCoverageCard and CurriculumProgressCard render weekly per ward from lessonPlans + syllabusTopics for the active term, respecting elective enrollments; the SyllabusDetailModal shows the full unit→chapter→topic tree with taught states.
AC-11: AssessmentScheduledCard shows for assessments within 14 days matching the ward's class/section; the modal shows date, type, coverage, maxMarks.

AC-12: The parent home feed is a reverse-chronological merged stream of academic posts and event cards with one pinned Needs Attention strip, pull-to-refresh, and a New posts pill; multi-ward merge works with per-card ward avatars.
AC-13: Every feed card type (new and existing) opens a populated detail modal in one tap; an automated check enumerates card types against their modal routes.

AC-14: Teacher homework CRUD is scope-enforced: a teacher cannot create/edit for a class-subject or section outside their allocations; submissions roster shows counts and allows marks/remarks updates.
AC-15: The syllabus tracker shows per-subject taught/pending topics and a pace InsightCard; teachers cannot mutate syllabus structure rows.
AC-16: The teacher feed shows the homework-due-tomorrow NeedsAttention card and the classwork-pending Today card from real data.
AC-17: The teacher and parent omniboxes resolve new intents ('homework', 'syllabus', 'post homework') to the new surfaces via the E6 resolvers with zero dead routes.

AC-18: Wiring audit pass: teacher grading/ptm/payroll and parent attendance/fees/bus/messages pages verified against real seeded data; any found mock, placeholder, or unscoped query is fixed and listed in the commit body.

AC-19: All new UI is bilingual (isHindi pattern), dark-mode complete, uses AppModal/ConfirmDialog/Combobox/EmptyStateCTA, offline-cached via the existing feed persistence, and adds zero npm dependencies.
constraints: Zero new npm dependencies; zero new tables expected — the curriculum schema already exists. A migration is permitted only if a column is strictly unavoidable, and must follow the migration journal pattern.

One phase per commit, tests green per phase, feat(academics)/fix(admissions)/feat(parent-app)/feat(teacher-app) prefixes per the established style.
Verify each defect D1-D8 against the repo before fixing; if already fixed at read time, skip and note in the commit body.

definition_of_done: A parent opens the app and sees their child's actual school life in one scrolling feed — homework posted tonight, what was taught today, where the class stands in the syllabus, what test is coming — every card opening real data, in their language, offline-safe. A teacher can produce that feed from their own phone in two or three taps. Every admission tells the truth: no phantom fees, no fake verification badges, no orphaned students, and no parent who logs in to find their child missing.
